name: Vivian Boone
source:
A single child, Vivian's father died when she was 10. Since then she has lived alone with her mother.
She lost her virginity when she was 15 to her second boyfriend but found the experience to be rather 'anticlimactic'.
Her only close friend is Desiree whom she met a year and a half ago in one of her college classes. The two have been inseparable ever since.
